text:
deploybot: Scheduled deploy window starting in 15m: api-service v2.3, runtime kernel v1.14.2, console schema v3.1 -> router header-swap flag enabled. See release notes link: https://go/release/6790011122 :rocket:
maya: Quick q — do we want to pin API v2.3 for the first wave? runtime change touches KV eviction behavior which could surface under load.
tom: +1 to pin. If runtime regresses we should be able to fallback without console/schema mismatch. What prefix for the rollback signal?
sanjay: Runtime kernel bump changes eviction window from 60s -> 45s under mem pressure. If router header-swap is on, some traffic may land on older runtime with incompatible headers; we need a compatibility switch.
elaine: Release notes draft in the doc — I added an ops checklist and migration steps for console schema. Will update if we decide pin windows.
ops-bot: Canary started: api-service v2.3 on 1% traffic -> instances: api-canary-3, runtime-canary-2. Monitoring groups: canary-health, latency-99.
deploybot: Canary health=OK (heartbeats green), latency +3ms median, errors 0.2% (baseline 0.15%). Continuing to 5% in 10m.
jonathan: For routing fallback — can we route by header-version and also have runtime fallback label? If kernel fails, route 100% to v2.2 until fixed.
priya: Proposal: pin API v2.3 at 5% for first 30m, console schema v3.1 pinned for 10m then unpin if no schema errors. Router header-swap gated behind feature flag off-by-default; flip only after 30m.
maya: Sounds safe. Add explicit rollback triggers: >1% error delta for 5m, latency p99 +100ms sustained 3m, or KV eviction spike >2x.
tom: I'll own the rollback. Command ready: `deploy rollback --service api-service --to=2.2 --reason="canary-fail"` — ops know the cadence.
sanjay: Also adding a runtime hotfix plan: if eviction regressions show, we can toggle runtime-eviction-tune in infra config to revert kernel heuristics.
elaine: I'll update release notes and console migration steps: include required client header fallback and example payload transformations.
ops-bot: Canary scaled to 5%: api-canary-10, runtime-canary-6. Metrics: errors 0.25%, latency median +4ms. Alert threshold not hit.
deploybot: Proceeding to staged rollout to EU region at 15% next window (in 20m) unless a rollback is triggered.
jonathan: One more ask — add a traffic-safety switch in router so we can quickly steer traffic away from EU region to US if we see regional degradations.
priya: I'll add the router switch and keep it manual for this rollout.
maya: Final decision: pin API v2.3 at 5% for 30m, console schema pinned 10m, router header-swap off and gated; rollback criteria as listed. Tom executes rollback if any trigger fires. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup: I'll be standing by.
sanjay: :thumbsup: Monitoring dashboards updated.
elaine: Release notes published and linked in the deploy playbook.
deploybot: Rollout progressing. Next status update in 10m or on any alert.
